article.story: BURLINGTON, Vt. -- — Noah Barnett's 16 points helped Vermont defeat Merrimack 66-59 on Sunday. Barnett added five rebounds for the Catamounts (7-5). Sean Blake added 14 points while shooting 6 of 7 from the field and 2 for 4 from the line while he also had five assists. TJ Long shot 4 of 11 from the field, including 1 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the line to finish with 13 points. Kevair Kennedy led the Warriors (6-7) in scoring, finishing with 20 points and seven assists. Merrimack also got 12 points from Tye Dorset. Ernest Shelton also recorded 11 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
